_comment: NeoAudit Guard-tests node (NEOAUDIT.md §7). Weekly, SCOPED mutation testing of the canonical financial engines — 'would the suite actually catch a broken formula?'. A surviving mutant = a test-gap → a MON ticket (issues:raise). Report-only (break: null): this NEVER blocks a PR; it runs weekly (or via workflow_dispatch). Uses the COMMAND runner (`npm test`) deliberately: it reuses the exact known-good invocation (vitest run --no-file-parallelism), sidestepping both the vitest-runner peer-compat question and the Prisma concurrent-construction flake documented in .github/workflows/tests.yml.
